The cargo lead discussed something about quiet areas after dinner
Smooth Boarding for Pets

Staff at Aurelia Skyways shared a calm reminder this week for travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Keep carriers labeled, keep water handy, and let the welcome team know early if a pet needs extra space or a quieter route through the terminal. <<FACT F028>> Clear notes help the crew match each animal with the right hold, rest stop, and transfer plan, and that keeps the process orderly for everyone involved.

At the same time, the desk is asking travelers to check relief-area signs before moving on, since small details can save delay at the gate. <<FACT F017>> If a pet such as Moose is traveling, the best practice is simple: stay with the carrier, listen for staff direction, and keep documents ready for review. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will continue to post practical updates for crews and passengers, so the trip stays steady from check-in through arrival.
